description: The full record for one component: description, install command, usage (imports + smallest working snippet), composition (part tree), examples, accessibility, motion & sound, prop table and anti-patterns. It's for before writing code that uses the component: the anti-patterns are the part a model gets wrong from priors.

name.description: Registry name ("echo-hardware-button"), bare name ("hardware-button") or title ("HardwareButton").
